panels.title: Payments made
panels.description: Payments that went through. 'before' is the same length of time right before the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
select (select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "now",
  (select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and received_hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) and received_hour < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "before"

panels.title: Payments that succeed
panels.description: Of the payments the wallet was asked to make. Not having enough funds is not counted as a failure. 'before' is the same length of time right before the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
select (select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "now",
  (select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds' and received_hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) and received_hour < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "before"

panels.title: Point, open app → paid
panels.description: The user points at the invoice, opens Rayl, and it pays without a tap: from the app starting to paid. Typical value (half are faster). 'before' is the same length of time right before the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
select (select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'process_to_outcome_ms' and (measures->>'camera_to_qr_ms')::numeric < 1500 and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "now",
  (select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'process_to_outcome_ms' and (measures->>'camera_to_qr_ms')::numeric < 1500 and received_hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) and received_hour < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "before"

panels.title: Code read → paid
panels.description: From the scanner reading the invoice to paid, without a tap. What the user waits for, however long the app was open before. Typical value. 'before' is the same length of time right before the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
select (select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'qr_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "now",
  (select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'qr_to_outcome_ms' and received_hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) and received_hour < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "before"

panels.title: App opens
panels.description: Cold starts that reached the foreground. 'before' is the same length of time right before the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
select (select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'launch' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "now",
  (select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'launch' and received_hour >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) and received_hour < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})) as "before"

panels.title: Where the time goes (typical, per step)
panels.description: The machine's share of a payment, step by step. The longest bar is where speeding up pays off. Aiming the camera and tapping are left out.

panels.title: Payments per day
panels.description: paid = went through. failed = the wallet said no. unknown = the wallet gave no answer. rejected = stopped before the wallet (for example not a valid invoice). dismissed = the user closed the confirmation.

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', received_hour) as time, dimensions->>'outcome' as metric, count(*) as value
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: What goes wrong
panels.description: Payment attempts that did not end in a payment, by reason. Empty is good.

panels.title: Wallets used
panels.description: Share of payments made with each wallet. rayl is the built-in wallet.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, count(*) as payments from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: How payments start
panels.description: scan = camera. input = pasted or typed. hub = started from a contact or shortcut in the Hub.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'source' as source, count(*) as payments from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc
